en-US.description: Manager of the PC's image files, including the ability to sort by people's faces.
en-US.longDescription:
Manager of the PC's image files, including the ability to sort by people's faces.

Note that as of July 2026, the recentmost version that has not been removed from Google's official servers (3.9.136.200), lags somewhat behind what proved to be the last version (3.9.141.259).
en-US.name: Picasa
